landingV2.title: Let your kids practice money
landingV2.lead: A playground for ages 12 to 18, with no real money. Money habits, saving, staying out of debt and starting a business.
landingV2.heroSceneAlt: Dr. Rho and Zara, two Mentors, with a flame, a book, a light bulb, a star, toy blocks and seeds floating around them.
landingV2.pathTitle: Four skills, one step at a time
landingV2.pathLead: They start with the basics and move up when they are ready, the way you learn a language.

path.name: Money habits
path.text: How they see money and what it is for: spending, wanting and choosing.

path.name: Saving
path.text: Set a goal, put money aside and watch it grow.

path.name: Staying out of debt
path.text: What borrowing really costs, and how to get out if it happens.

path.name: Starting a business
path.text: Turn an idea into something of their own.

landingV2.problemLink: Yet many reach adulthood without learning to manage money:
landingV2.problemFact: adults in the US don’t understand money basics.
landingV2.problemBridge: So your child can start practicing today, with no real risk.
landingV2.problemSources: Sources: University of Cambridge, 2013 · S&P Global FinLit Survey, 2014

principles.name: No real money, ever
principles.text: Everything happens in a practice world. Nothing they do here touches a bank account or a card.

principles.name: Their decisions, their results
principles.text: Your child chooses, sees what happens and tries again. That is how a habit starts to feel like theirs.

landingV2.ctaTitle: Give your kids a place to practice
